card.statement:
Let $D$ be an effective Cartier divisor in $X$ , and let $Z\subset X$ be a closed subscheme of codimension $1$ . We define the following prestacks over $\mathsf{Aff}/X$ (where, for simplicity, we write $*$ for $X$ viewed as a (pre)stack over $\mathsf{Aff}/X$ , i.e. the final prestack over $\mathsf{Aff}/X$ ).

•

For $(\mathcal{F},\mathring{\mathcal{F}})=\mathopen{}\mathclose{{\left(\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{Z}}\smallsetminus D},\mathcal{F}_{({\widehat{Z}}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z)\smallsetminus D}}}\right)$ , we define

$\mathbf{Gr}_{D,Z}^{L}:=\mathbf{Bun}_{\widehat{Z}\smallsetminus D}\times_{\mathbf{Bun}_{(\widehat{Z}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z)\smallsetminus D}}\{*\}\,\,\,\,\in\mathsf{PSt}(\mathsf{Aff}/X)$

to be the geometric Grassmannian of the loop group at the fixed flag $(D,Z)$ .
The corresponding stack over $k$ , as in (2.2), will be denoted as $\underline{\mathbf{Gr}}_{D,Z}^{L,\sharp}$ .

•

For $(\mathcal{F},\mathring{\mathcal{F}})=\mathopen{}\mathclose{{\left(\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{Z}}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z}^{\mathrm{aff}},\mathcal{F}_{({\widehat{Z}}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z)\smallsetminus D}}}\right)$ , we define

${}^{L}\mathbf{Gr}_{D,Z}:=\mathbf{Bun}_{(\widehat{Z}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z)^{\mathrm{aff}}}\times_{\mathbf{Bun}_{(\widehat{Z}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z)\smallsetminus D}}\{*\}\,\,\,\,\in\mathsf{PSt}(\mathsf{Aff}/X)$

to be the geometric loop Grassmannian at the fixed flag $(D,Z)$ .
The corresponding stack over $k$ , as in (2.2), will be denoted as ${}^{L}\underline{\mathbf{Gr}}_{D,Z}^{\sharp}$ .

•

For $(\mathcal{F},\mathring{\mathcal{F}})=\mathopen{}\mathclose{{\left(\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{Z}}}^{\mathrm{aff}},\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{Z}}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z}}}\right)$ , we define

$\mathbf{Gr}_{D,Z}^{J}:=\mathbf{Bun}_{{\widehat{Z}}^{\mathrm{aff}}}\times_{\mathbf{Bun}_{\widehat{Z}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z}}\{*\}\,\,\,\,\in\mathsf{PSt}(\mathsf{Aff}/X)$

to be the geometric jet Grassmannian at the fixed flag $(D,Z)$ .
The corresponding stack over $k$ , as in (2.2), will be denoted as $\underline{\mathbf{Gr}}_{D,Z}^{J,\sharp}$ .

•

For $(\mathcal{F},\mathring{\mathcal{F}})=\mathopen{}\mathclose{{\left(\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{Z}}}^{\mathrm{aff}},\mathcal{F}_{({\widehat{Z}}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z)\smallsetminus D}}}\right)$ , we define

$\mathbf{Gr}_{D,Z}^{\mathrm{big}}:=\mathbf{Bun}_{\widehat{Z}}\times_{\mathbf{Bun}_{(\widehat{Z}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z)\smallsetminus D}}\{*\}\,\,\,\,\in\mathsf{PSt}(\mathsf{Aff}/X)$

to be the geometric big Grassmannian at the fixed flag $(D,Z)$ .
The corresponding stack over $k$ , as in (2.2), will be denoted as $\underline{\mathbf{Gr}}_{D,Z}^{\mathrm{big},\sharp}$ .

•

For $(\mathcal{F},\mathring{\mathcal{F}})=\mathopen{}\mathclose{{\left(\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{Z}}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z}^{\mathrm{aff}}\coprod_{\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{Z}}^{D}\smallsetminus Z}}\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{Z}}^{D}}^{\mathrm{aff}},\mathcal{F}_{({\widehat{Z}}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z)\smallsetminus D}}}\right)$ , we define

$\mathbf{Gr}^{(2)}_{D,Z}:=(\,\mathbf{Bun}_{(\widehat{Z}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z)^{\mathrm{aff}}}\times_{\mathbf{Bun}_{\widehat{Z}^{D}\smallsetminus Z}}\mathbf{Bun}_{\widehat{Z}^{D}}\,)\times_{\mathbf{Bun}_{(\widehat{Z}^{\widehat{D}}\smallsetminus Z)\smallsetminus D}}\{*\}\,\,\,\,\in\mathsf{PSt}(\mathsf{Aff}/X)$

to be the geometric 2-dimensional local field Grassmannian at the fixed flag $(D,Z)$ .
The corresponding stack over $k$ , as in (2.2), will be denoted as $\underline{\mathbf{Gr}}_{D,Z}^{(2),\sharp}$ .
card.label: Definition 2.10

paper.title: Two dimensional versions of the affine Grassmannian and their geometric description
paper.abstract: For a smooth affine algebraic group $G$ over an algebraically closed field, we consider several two-variables generalizations of the affine Grassmannian $G(\!(t)\!)/G[\![t]\!]$, given by quotients of the double loop group $G(\!(x)\!)(\!(y)\!)$. We prove that they are representable by ind-schemes if $G$ is solvable. Given a smooth surface $X$ and a flag of subschemes of $X$, we provide a geometric interpretation of the two-variables Grassmannians, in terms of bundles and trivialisation data defined on appropriate loci in $X$, which depend on the flag.
